name: Mahj Over Matter
description: Organizer of American Mahjong lessons and social/open-play events in Rockville, North Bethesda and Chevy Chase. Event page: "This Veterans Day event combines American Mahjong with food and drinks"; boot camp page lists "NMJL card reading".
schedule: Recurring events at restaurants and a private Mahj Room in Chevy Chase; see events page

name: Bender JCC of Greater Washington
description: JCC offering multi-week Mah Jongg classes. Class page: "Players learn the basic rules of American Mah Jongg, including tile identification, the Charleston, how to read the National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) card, and how to form a hand."
schedule: Beginner and intermediate Mah Jongg series, ages 18+; monthly sessions
